task: T23.47 account-scoped billing operation locks follow-up
design: Ref-counted context-aware keyed locks serialize provider operations per account and duplicate webhook delivery per event. The map mutex is held only for entry/refcount bookkeeping. Webhook first provider read validates subscription/customer identity only and resolves the server-owned account mapping; after acquiring that account lock it rechecks the stored customer binding, refetches the subscription, validates identity again, then performs projection reads and writes. Event lock is always acquired before account lock. Durable event receipt remains unprocessed on every failure.
regressions_added: A blocked provider call for account A does not prevent account B reconciliation.
Checkout and closure for one account do not overlap provider reads.
A webhook identity fetch paused before its account lock cannot apply its stale snapshot after reconciliation; it refetches under the account lock.
A canceled lock waiter returns promptly, preserves an entry still held by another caller, and idle entries are reclaimed.
Webhook and reconciliation reject canceled/unpaid/paused, expired active periods, and expired past_due grace for account-plan eligibility; active/future period and future grace retain plan.
Deleting and restore_pending account states remain free and reconciliation remains frozen.
Expired grace keeps the exact persisted deadline while returning ineligible; malformed persisted grace aborts reconciliation without partial plan/subscription updates.

validation.red_baseline: Runtime regressions on the old projection reproduced account plan builder for canceled/unpaid/paused and expired active/past_due states, incorrect Eligible=true for expired active/past_due, and malformed-grace error after a partial plan update.

implementation: Added context-aware ref-counted per-account and per-event locks. Map mutex protects only registry/ref bookkeeping; provider work runs outside it. Cancellation drops waiter references without removing a still-held entry.
Webhook first read resolves only validated subscription/customer identity, then checks the server-owned account binding under lock and refetches authoritative subscription state before projection.

Aligned account plan projection and ReconcileResult.Eligible with effective access: active/trialing require future period end; past_due requires its unchanged persisted grace deadline to remain in the future; non-active account states remain free.
